headline: Bank bond interest rates rise sharply, with many issues approaching 10% per year
summary: Commercial banks in Vietnam are accelerating bond issuance at rising rates, with many issues carrying 9% a year or more and some approaching 10%. The rise reflects higher costs of raising long-term capital.
why: Bank bond yields in Vietnam indicate funding costs for lenders and tightness in the domestic credit market. Rising costs can affect lending rates and banking-sector earnings.
